title: 15.33. Sāsavaduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Sāsavaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naanāsavo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anāsavaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naanāsavo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
Sāsavaṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naanāsavo naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Sāsavaṁ abyākataṁ dhammaṁ paccayā nasāsavo naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
